commands.name: co-lookup
commands.label: Lookup
commands.description: Performs a lookup of logged block and player data.

inputs.name: params
inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.placeholder: e.g. u:Notch t:1h r:#world_nether a:-block (u:<user> t:<time> r:<#world|#global> a:<action> i:<include> e:<exclude>)

commands.name: co-rollback
commands.label: Rollback
commands.description: Performs a rollback to revert player actions.

inputs.name: params
inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.placeholder: e.g. u:Notch t:1h r:#world (u:<user> t:<time> r:<#world|#global> a:<action> i:<include> e:<exclude>; numeric radius needs a player)

commands.name: co-restore
commands.label: Restore
commands.description: Performs a restore to undo rollbacks or restore player actions.

inputs.name: params
inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.placeholder: e.g. u:Notch t:1h r:#world (u:<user> t:<time> r:<#world|#global> a:<action> i:<include> e:<exclude>; numeric radius needs a player)

commands.name: co-undo
commands.label: Undo
commands.description: Reverts the last rollback or restore by running the opposite action.

commands.name: co-purge
commands.label: Purge
commands.description: Deletes old block data; from the console only data older than 24 hours can be purged.

inputs.name: params
inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.placeholder: e.g. t:30d r:#world_nether (t:<time> r:<#world> i:<include> e:<exclude> a:kill #optimize)

commands.name: co-status
commands.label: Status
commands.description: Displays the plugin status and version information.

commands.name: co-consumer
commands.label: Toggle consumer
commands.description: Pauses or resumes consumer queue processing.

commands.name: co-migrate-db
commands.label: Migrate database
commands.description: Migrates data from the active database backend to a different backend.
